scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n shared,server,client -c gray,blue,green "npm run dev -w @game/shared" "npm run dev -w @game/server" "npm run dev -w @game/client"
scripts.sandbox: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @game/client -- --open /sandbox
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @game/server && npm run build -w @game/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
